lines: Old Faithful has never erupted on the hour.
Old Faithful has NEVER erupted on the HOUR.
M
Wait, never? Isn't that the whole point?
Wait, NEVER? Isn't that the whole POINT?
F
That's the myth. The real trick is weirder. Rangers predict it from the last eruption.
That's the MYTH. The real trick is WEIRDER. Rangers predict it from the LAST eruption.
M
Okay. Where are we?
Okay. Where ARE we?
F
Yellowstone. About half of all the world's geysers are here. And this one blasts up to eight thousand four hundred gallons of boiling water, a hundred and eighty four feet high.
YELLOWSTONE. About HALF of all the world's geysers are here. And this one blasts up to 8,400 GALLONS of boiling water, 184 FEET high.
M
So what's actually down there?
So what's actually DOWN there?
F
In the early nineteen nineties, scientists lowered a camera into the vent. Twenty two feet down, the pipe squeezes to just a few inches wide.
In the early 1990s, scientists lowered a CAMERA into the vent. 22 FEET down, the pipe squeezes to just a FEW INCHES wide.
M
A few inches? For all that water?
A few INCHES? For ALL that water?
F
And below it, a cavern about the size of a small car.
And below it, a CAVERN about the size of a small CAR.
M
So it's a pressure cooker. Rain and snow seep down, magma heats the rock, and the water gets hotter than boiling. But the weight above won't let it boil.
So it's a PRESSURE COOKER. Rain and snow seep down, MAGMA heats the rock, and the water gets HOTTER than boiling. But the WEIGHT above won't let it boil.
F
Until a little spills out the top. The pressure drops, and the whole column flashes into steam.
Until a little SPILLS out the top. The PRESSURE drops, and the whole column FLASHES into steam.
M
So how do rangers call the next one?
So how do rangers CALL the next one?
F
They time the eruption. A short one empties less, so the next comes in about sixty eight minutes. A long one? About ninety four.
They TIME the eruption. A SHORT one empties less, so the next comes in about 68 MINUTES. A LONG one? About 94.
M
And that works?
And that WORKS?
F
About nine times out of ten, within ten minutes. So it is faithful. Just never on the hour.
About 9 times out of 10, within 10 MINUTES. So it IS faithful. Just NEVER on the hour.

Follow for a new wonder every day.
